description: This file is a Python script that seeds a database with roles, skills, and role-skill relationships for a career pathway navigator application. It defines functions for creating or fetching skills, attaching skills to roles with specified levels, and a main function 'seed_minimal_dataset' which sets up core roles, skills, their relationships, and some initial progress data.

methods.name: List[Skill] _ensure_skills(skill_repo: SkillRepository, specs: List[Tuple[str, str, str]])
methods.description: Creates or retrieves skills by name based on provided specifications.

methods.name: None _attach_role_skills( role_repo: RoleRepository, rec_repo: RecommendationRepository, role_name: str, role_skill_levels: Dict[str, int], )
methods.description: Attaches skills to a specified role with given levels, optionally adding recommendations for certain roles and skills.

methods.name: None seed_minimal_dataset(session: Session)
methods.description: Main function to seed the database with core roles, extended roles, associated skills, predefined role-skill levels, and some baseline progress.
